dynamics.disturbance_semantics: independent stagewise additive disturbance; observed after each control is applied

feedback.information_pattern: full state x_t observed before control u_t; no future disturbance observed

objective.formula: sum(t=0..T-1, x_t^T I x_t + u_t^2) + x_T^T I x_T
objective.nominal_surrogate: same formula evaluated on z_t and v_t
objective.claim_boundary: evaluates one fixed nominal plan and one fixed ancillary feedback gain; does not optimize K or v and is not a minimax-optimality claim

arithmetic: all model, policy, cost, and disturbance values are exact rational numbers
